title: 2.1 Basic Concepts of Climate Change
description: Climate versus weather, global warming, the IPCC definition and the interconnection of Earth systems. Easy level.

questions.question: What does climate refer to?
options: It links crustal movement to the formation of landforms
They have larger amplitude and travel along the surface
They raise pastoralist incomes while limiting emissions
Conditions of the atmosphere in a place over many years
questions.correctAnswer: Conditions of the atmosphere in a place over many years

questions.question: What does weather refer to?
options: The long-term climate of a continent
It was replaced without leaving any legacy
Atmospheric conditions on a particular day
questions.correctAnswer: Atmospheric conditions on a particular day

questions.question: What is the average climate around the world called?
What is global warming?
options: A long-term increase in Earth average temperature
The distribution of fossils and the ages of rocks
The plate pushes mountains upward without melting
They proved a volcanic origin for both continents
questions.correctAnswer: A long-term increase in Earth average temperature

questions.question: According to the IPCC, how long must a climate change persist?

options: It rained yesterday in Addis Ababa
